segments.name: Financing Solutions
segments.description: Provides financing solutions enabling automobile dealers to sell vehicles to consumers with impaired or limited credit histories.
segments.evidence: We currently operate in one reportable segment which represents our core business of offering innovative financing solutions and related products and services that enable Dealers to sell vehicles to consumers regardless of their credit history.

revenueModel.text: Automobile dealers and consumers pay through finance charges on loans, reinsurance premiums on vehicle service contracts, and ancillary product fees.
